claims.explanation: Bergenin's anti-inflammatory activity via PPARγ agonism and NF-κB/MAPK inhibition, with suppression of IL-1β/TNF-α, likely kills cancer lines dependent on these inflammatory survival pathways. Sensitivity is enriched in lines with EGFR mutation, PTEN loss, and SWI/SNF (ARID1A/SMARCA4) or STK11 mutations, while CDKN2A loss may confer resistance.
